description: A workspace that groups related features and flows for one user.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Hex color used in the UI.

fields.name: customEnvs
fields.description: JSON-encoded list of {slug, label, color} added per-project beyond the canonical dev/stg/prod/uat envs.

fields.name: envLabelOverrides
fields.description: JSON-encoded map of per-project label overrides for canonical envs (key = canonical slug like "dev", value = display label). Custom-env labels are stored in `customEnvs`; canonical-env overrides live here so the slug stays reserved but the visible label can be tailored per project.
